name: Essential Video Effects
description: Colour fixes, blurs, glow, glitch, green screen, warps, beauty makeup, grading tools, and more — the everyday effects for cleaning up and styling clips.
details: GPU shader effect library (GLSL). Colour adjustment (exposure, highlights/shadows/whites/blacks, vibrance, green/magenta tint, HSL hue/sat/luma), blurs, glitch, glow, stylise, chroma key / green screen, face warps, beauty/makeup (lipstick, blush, eyes, teeth), plus addon-only warps, light rays, CDL/levels, grain and weather overlays. Package id: effects.core.
author: CutWire
